## About
Don's Auto Trim started with one truck and a lot of hard work. In the early days, the crew traveled to clients every day and did the work on-site. Over the years the business grew and opened a retail store, the shop you'll find today on Rockville Road in Indianapolis.
We still do on-site installation when it's needed, and we keep a large inventory of parts on hand. Our goal is simple: to satisfy every customer with good workmanship and quality materials. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 126 Google reviews.

## Services
- Heated seats: We can put heated seats in your car. One reviewer said the job was finished in a timely manner and the pricing was very reasonable.
- Seat foam and fabric: One customer's driver's seat foam broke and pushed the frame through the fabric. He said the finished seat looks brand new.
- New tops: We put new tops on cars, including a 1991 Buick Reatta that one customer said fits better than new.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you do the work at my location?
A: When it's necessary, yes. We still perform on-site installation. Give us a call to talk through your job.

Q: What happens if something about the work is not right?
A: Please let us know right away. If you are not fully satisfied with the workmanship or the materials, we want to hear about it so the issue can be resolved.
